sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_first_order then member_id end) AS first_buyer_count
  , SUM(case when is_first_order then net_cents else 0 end) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , SUM(CASE WHEN case when is_first_order then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN case when not is_first_order then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_order_count
FROM "data"."main"."order_validity" order_validity_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
answer: 青禾2026年8月（2026-08-01至2026-08-31，按订单日期归属）在CRM会员账户口径下：观测期首购会员数为5个账户，观测期首单净销售额为128.00元，观测期首单数为5笔，观测期后续购买订单数为22笔。口径说明：首购会员指在测试覆盖期内首次有效订单落入该月的不同CRM账户数（不代表终身首购）；首单净销售额按各账户第一笔有效订单的净销售额合计；后续购买订单指各账户第二笔及以后的有效订单落入该月计数，不等于月内复购人数。
